about: P24 acceptance register. Cases A01-A72 come from manual S19, requirements C01-C39 from S20 (stages and cases copied exactly; tests/acceptance/test_traceability.py checks them against the manual). Each case names the tests asserting its observable outcome. Each requirement names its rule authorities, the caller paths enforcing it (checked statically on every run), the source files it depends on, and extra tests. focus/release/acceptance.py runs the suite and judges every entry.

A01.summary: No credentials and no source run: imports and pages succeed with typed no-data states; nothing acquires, solves, writes or grades on import or GET

A02.summary: Only the local focus package is imported; optional solver, LLM and SQL packages are lazy and the fixture path works without them

A03.summary: All 51 aircraft reconciled, including a fully blocked one and one missing standards; no eligibility or top-50 exclusion; reasons and inventory kept

A04.summary: Same SOI on two lines and two revisions keep distinct lossless keys through graph, durations, parts, serialization and UI

A05.summary: A failed mandatory dataset never becomes head; certified empty differs from unavailable; the old head stays

A06.summary: A CS dataset from another run or generation fails admission; a changed declared hash cannot cure the evidence mismatch

A07.summary: A crash before the head update leaves no partial run; replaying the idempotency key gives one receipt and head, no duplicate facts

A08.summary: SQL team inference breaks ties deterministically with tie flag, count, window and confidence; department fallback is labeled and persisted

A09.summary: An effective assignment overrides inference at the exact instant; inference never asserts present executable capacity

A10.summary: True repeats dedupe; a conflicting overlapping assignment fails admission; no double headcount or double booking

A11.summary: A certified mechanic of the wrong team or shift is never borrowed; work waits with a reason; no phantom mechanic

A12.summary: Only an individual superset of the required certs qualifies; a union across two people is rejected; approved OR alternatives are checked separately

A13.summary: Whole-interval eligibility rejects expiring, revoked, future, blank or malformed certs; equivalent date encodings agree; the sentinel policy is explicit

A14.summary: Unknown rework requirements block and are never cleared; an affirmative no-cert receipt may proceed; a SUBST label alone grants nothing

A15.summary: Composite flow lookup keeps each line's source fields; TOTAL drives demand; zero, null or negative counts are unavailable, never a default of 1

A16.summary: Running-max union gives active elapsed 100 without bridging gaps or double-counting nested intervals; owner unions give effort independently

A17.summary: P50/P55/mean/P75/P90 persist with n, window and units; scheduled rework P75 uses the elapsed cohort, not effort divided by crew

A18.summary: Selecting P90 makes a new policy and plan only, prior goals unchanged; no false mean ordering; an unavailable cohort is never a flat 60

A19.summary: The per-line active calendar wins; holes and out-of-bounds dates block; no weekday arithmetic fallback or automatic extension

A20.summary: S3 on a nonworking day needs same-line next-day working evidence; Saturday before a nonworking Sunday is denied; S1/S2 on nonworking days are denied

A21.summary: A normal working-day S3 is allowed in its admitted window; UTC endpoints are built independently across DST

A22.summary: Starts at cutoff-1 and cutoff are allowed, cutoff+1 is rejected; OT never moves the cutoff; finish fit is checked separately

A23.summary: The exact station is chosen; earliest, gate and due stay distinct; past and day-0 gates are retained; no min/max widening

A24.summary: Raw CS signs and lineage are preserved; conflicting loads or a missing date policy block; no guessed MAX(load), anchor or date convention

A25.summary: An incomplete predecessor must finish first; a missing prerequisite, self-edge or cycle is diagnosed and never satisfied by deletion

A26.summary: An in-progress job keeps its incoming edge and actual history; unsafe continuation is held; no backdating, restart fiction or OOS-only legalization

A27.summary: Each rework gate is injected once; the unstarted root waits for rework and QA; a started root uses the documented hold

A28.summary: Reverse or cyclic rework is quarantined and closure blocked; verified lifecycle revisions decide release; no cycle-edge deletion

A29.summary: A shortage gates the correct line-A root and descendants by the latest release; the same SOI on line B is unaffected; unknown rows stay blocked or conditional

A30.summary: A forecast never precedes its precision-aware floor; date-only ECD floors at end of day and is labeled; dispatch needs current ready evidence; reopen reblocks

A31.summary: Production elapsed is conserved; in-process QA allocations sum to 45, not 90; no invented midpoint when hold points are unknown

A32.summary: Separate 90 QA minutes when both apply; every successor is gated by all required releases; FS means >=

A33.summary: One qualified inspector never overlaps; production hold and retained crew duty follow policy; no unlimited QA pool or empty-cert inspector

A34.summary: An exact full crew of distinct eligible people or wait; roles respect team, shift and individual certs; no demand clamp

A35.summary: Work 420 plus two 15-minute transfers is duty 450 with 20 OT; without OT it is rejected; transfers count once

A36.summary: Duty 490 is allowed within authorized windows, 491 is rejected; carry-in occupancy is checked across shift labels

A37.summary: Pure pools of 0, 1, 2 and 10 cap at exactly 0, 0, 1 and 8 on the deduplicated admitted denominator; no minimum of one or second derate

A38.summary: Every binder, repair or continuity move that would activate a ninth of ten people is rejected or returns an explicit failed candidate; V8 catches a forged plan

A39.summary: A-B-A switching costs a transition each way for every member; B starts at 75 with baseline 15; real reservations for the whole crew

A40.summary: Insert, remove or swap recomputes both neighbor transitions atomically; travel across a protected break or a busy tool blocks

A41.summary: Prefer the feasible lower opportunity-cost person with fewer usable certs and aircraft affinity; overrides are explained with real travel

A42.summary: Ready commitments first; attempt 1 is the exact slot and crew, attempt 2 the same time with an alternate full crew; day 3 is free; outcomes recorded

A43.summary: Only the accepted incumbent is reloaded; a late part, expired cert or changed calendar overrides the defense immediately with a reason

A44.summary: The CLI rich MAX consumes registry weights and complete aircraft completion; economic steering improves exact fleet cost over the neutral seed

A45.summary: The exact full-candidate evaluator governs acceptance; no improvement claim from weights alone; unknown completion is never zero

A46.summary: Assumed and actual terms are labeled; no fabricated rate, liability or due; supported zero differs from unknown

A47.summary: Every V1-V9 and extended corruption is caught after each mutation; in-progress work is not skipped; coverage is nonzero; the plan cannot publish

A48.summary: Detached and pre-sign readback each reject changed crew, root edge, timezone, station/load, offset or source hash; corrupted bytes are never signed or promoted

A49.summary: Under 2 days holds; 7 or more days worse is immediate; other changes need two distinct confirmations; safety risk is immediately visible

A50.summary: Replays, rejections, cohort exit and re-entry, and a crash before acknowledgment add no streak or duplicate change and forget no commitment

A51.summary: A crash at stage, readback, signing, acceptance, pointer update or client timeout keeps the previous pointer until atomic acceptance; recovery reconciles exactly

A52.summary: Tampered signature or hash, replayed artifact, wrong scope, skipped check, synthetic capability or unauthorized signer never accepts or dispatches

A53.summary: A revoked cert, reopened shortage, incomplete predecessor or withdrawn attendance blocks current dispatch and requests repair; history stays immutable

A54.summary: All eight causes and duplicate claims: five nominal categories exact; evidence and decision separate; relief union bounded by frozen missed effort

A55.summary: Explicit defect-origin evidence decides culpability; no causation guess from DAG direction; no automatic 3x overrun excuse

A56.summary: No credit for cancellation; prior verified work follows the ordered policy; original goals preserved; corrections append a new evaluation

A57.summary: Demonstration scores 65, 50 and 0; no free 30 points, throughput substitute or UI formula drift

A58.summary: Approved relief case scores 100; all-excused or no plan is neutral null; missing evidence is unknown null; B0 retained

A59.summary: Pooled D400/Cp200 with D100/Cp100 scores 72, not the 82.5 average; team, factory and history surfaces agree

A60.summary: Planned OOS gives O20 and score 90 with Cp unchanged; unapproved off-plan OOS is not double charged; XP and economics never subtract O again

A61.summary: Actual gate ages 0,2,3,5,7 give raw 0,.4,.6,1,1; proxy grace applies once; a future gate is 0 and an absent one unavailable

A62.summary: A frozen recognition value earns once, never ages after completion, and a correction appends a revision instead of rewriting XP

A63.summary: No duplicated XP or badge across repeats and month transitions; awards name verified events; qualification never derives from XP

A64.summary: Exactly 10 distinct virtual people per configured MHE/PSC/TST team-shift with union certs; forecast-labeled; rejected from executable crews by origin evidence

A65.summary: Twin drilldowns give the same canonical totals and revisions; observed, planned, forecast and unknown stay separate; scenarios never move live pointers, goals or commitments

A66.summary: Mock and recorded explanations use actual ids; forged candidates, numbers, entities, units or narrative are rejected; the deterministic fallback is unchanged

A67.summary: Prompt injection, nonfinite or extra fields, timeouts and missing BCAI credentials cause no tool use, mutation or secret leak; schedule and rank unchanged

A68.summary: Scope before fetch; CSRF, version and idempotency enforced; GET never solves, writes or grades; commands return honest worker status

A69.summary: iOS and Classic are accessible with the same facts at 375/390, tablet and desktop, keyboard and reduced motion; no overflow or hardcoded Ready/100; travel, parts and QA reasons visible

A70.summary: Whole-WIP benchmark: zero required skips and violations, complete inventory, bounded runtime and memory; solver timeout, unavailability or invalid incumbent falls back truthfully

A71.summary: Needs, locks and idempotency block races and promotion; migrations are reviewable and reversible; unsigned readback strictly precedes signing

A72.summary: A fresh checkout completes the documented fixture flow; a new versioned review preserves historical review files; unresolved live gates are listed precisely

C11.requirement: Separate final 45-minute FS inspection before successors

C12.requirement: Distinct CS earliest/deadline/gate, same-run source lineage

C15.requirement: Three shifts and working budget plus at most 60 allowance

C16.requirement: Nonworking-d shift 3 iff d+1 working on same line

C18.requirement: Per-person complete duty load cap and OT

C19.requirement: No-start cutoff effective minus 30, equality allowed

C20.requirement: Consecutive aircraft switch time and changeover penalty

C22.requirement: Fewer usable certs and rare-skill crew conservation

C24.requirement: Enabled, 3 calendar days, exact two-attempt defense

C26.requirement: Parts ETA floor on every scan/mutation/status

C29.requirement: Seven-day bad news immediately and sustained other changes

C30.requirement: Eight disruption codes and five nominal excusables

C31.requirement: Effort points, progression, badges, streams and XP

C35.requirement: Exactly 10 fictitious MHE/PSC/TST union-cert support people

C36.requirement: Mock/recorded/BCAI explanation providers and strict validation

C37.requirement: Stable nine-check suite with independent mandatory enforcement

C38.requirement: In-progress never voids incoming incomplete predecessor
